mapper.select: SELECT ec.*, fc.num AS case_num, fc.name AS case_name FROM ai_execution_case ec LEFT JOIN functional_case fc ON fc.id = ec.case_id WHERE ec.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY ec.pos ASC, ec.create_time ASC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) FROM ai_execution_event WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_execution_task ( id, organization_id, project_id, test_plan_id, source, status, runner_id, provider_id, environment_id, target_url, browser_type, login_mode, idempotency_key, confirm_required, confirmation_reason, total_count, success_count, failed_count, blocked_count, skipped_count, unexecuted_count, executed_by, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{organizationId}, #{projectId}, #{testPlanId}, #{source}, #{status}, #{runnerId}, #{providerId}, #{environmentId}, #{targetUrl}, #{browserType}, #{loginMode}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{confirmRequired}, #{confirmationReason}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{failedCount}, #{blockedCount}, #{skippedCount}, #{unexecutedCount}, #{executedBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_execution_task SET status = #{status}, success_count = #{successCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, blocked_count = #{blockedCount}, skipped_count = #{skippedCount}, unexecuted_count = #{unexecutedCount}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE ai_execution_case SET status = 'CREATED', result = NULL, retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = NULL, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'BLOCKED')
mapper.select:
SELECT tp.id, tp.name, tp.project_id AS projectId, tp.status, tp.num, COALESCE(fc.case_count, 0) AS associatedCaseCount FROM test_plan tp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT test_plan_id, COUNT(1) AS case_count FROM test_plan_functional_case GROUP BY test_plan_id ) fc ON fc.test_plan_id = tp.id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN tp.status IN ('UNDERWAY', 'RUNNING', 'IN_PROGRESS') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, tp.update_time DESC, tp.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

sql.where:
fc.project_id = #{projectId} AND fc.deleted = 0 AND fc.latest = 1
AND ( LOWER(fc.id) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{likeKeyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR LOWER(fc.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{likeKeyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR CAST(fc.num AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' )

mapper.select:
SELECT NULL AS id, NULL AS task_id, fc.project_id, fc.id AS case_id, fc.num AS case_num, fc.name AS case_name, NULL AS test_plan_id, NULL AS test_plan_case_id, NULL AS status, fc.last_execute_result AS result, 0 AS pos, 0 AS retry_count, NULL AS error_message, fc.create_time, fc.update_time FROM functional_case fc
ORDER BY fc.pos ASC, fc.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
